title: Modules over a group ring have functorial injective embeddings
statement: Let $G$ be a group and $R$ a ring. The category of left modules over the group ring $R[G]$, with $R[G]$-linear maps, has functorial injective embeddings: there are a functor $J$ and a natural transformation $j:\operatorname{id}\to J$ such that every component $j_M$ is a monomorphism and every $J(M)$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions].
